scope: Offline reconstruction of one actual headed release RTC run. No new browser, network, build or timing experiment.

anchors: 335-345: startup observer before connect, CPU throttle after openProbe
448-507: final RTC/candidate/channel, tape and confirmation gates
Connection observation precedes canonical admission; exact timeout firing unobserved
305,328-347: route latch, timeout and all-peer readiness

cpuThrottle.scope: openProbe and after-open counters precede CPU throttling; subsequent netplay setup and first game callback use the configured per-side rates.

headedLaunch.scope: Window-mode environment control, not a production code change; proxy, input, audio/context, CPU setup, and native GPU arguments are unchanged.

originalScope: Two separate desktop Chromium processes; native GPU; real RTC with synchronous client send; no injected send timers; wire-verified frame-indexed hosted-key tape; sampled SDL output blocks, not speaker/acoustic acceptance
originalPresentationMeasurement: RAF timestamps of callbacks with a new renderer submission; NOT physical scanout. Completion gaps are reported separately because varying callback work is not itself a missed vsync.

statements: 双方最终候选均为 succeeded 的 host-to-host UDP；输入通道保留 unordered/maxRetransmits=0，控制通道保留 ordered/可靠配置。
正式 frame 180..899 接近 60 Hz，不能覆盖启动段的连接构造等待与首帧重活。
这是本机两浏览器进程的真实 RTC 运行，不能外推公网 NAT、TURN 或深度回滚；结束时的 ICE 快照也不是全程候选跟踪。
本轮不能单独归因输入合并的 CPU 收益，也不抹去此前失败的 headless/direct 或有停顿的 relay 运行。

signaling.matchingScope: FIFO per side/socket-kind/type/description-type/candidate-present/from/to/player/peers/mode; no SDP or candidate payload fingerprint. Every unmatched observation is retained.

relaySnapshot.scope: Existing relay JS text receive/send and connection/close boundaries. Connection observation precedes canonical admission; no SDP, candidate text, URLs, addresses, credentials or error messages retained. Route timer firing is not instrumented; deadline attribution requires explicit inference.

signaling.unmatchedInterpretation: Both unmatched relay sends are route=rtc on player sockets. Signaling-socket route observations and player closes are retained separately; the missing messages remain unmatched, not relabeled as received.

timeout.limitation: Connection hook runs before canonical admission. These are observed intervals, not an instrumented timer start/fire. Relay selected RTC after both ready receipts; no changed timeout or forced fallback.

inputRelayTrace.scope: Relay startup/signaling observed. Zero E9NP relay input events are expected here. NETWORK_TRACE=0: browser RTC input receive/poll timings are unavailable.

ending.limitation: Final peer frames differ. Compare seven matching confirmed checkpoints and exact first 900 local input values. Retain extra captures, pending RAFs, and nonzero channel bufferedAmount; do not compare final hashes or claim all data drained.

snapshot.scope: Read-only host CPU counters and candidate process CPU counters. No performance samples are excluded or reweighted.
limitations: Aggregate CPU occupancy does not establish single-core availability, CPU frequency, thermal state, GPU load, or a stable benchmark environment.
Process names are candidates for contention, not proof that a process is compiling. Known harness/relay/helper PIDs are labeled separately; other node processes remain unlabeled candidates.
Process CPU is cumulative lifetime CPU seconds. A first sighting is not CPU consumed during this run; PID reuse or counter reset can break a delta.
The 5 s process snapshots miss short tasks that start and exit between snapshots. Timer delays and source/receive times are retained.
This observer has overhead. Its own PowerShell helper is intentionally not a candidate process, but its work is included in aggregate CPU counters.
Overflow and sampling failures make this evidence incomplete; they are never a reason to silently remove a game result.

host.interpretation: No samples filtered or adjusted. valid/complete means observation completeness, not a quiet host. First-seen process CPU is lifetime; 5 s snapshots miss short compilers. Aggregate occupancy does not establish single-core/GPU/frequency/thermal stability.

headed.scope: Only the two browsers created by this harness. CDP supplies the unique browser PID; CIM reads only that PID. Save only command-line SHA256 and allowlisted flags, never raw command lines, executable/profile paths, or process lists. Missing identity observation is explicit and cannot establish a matched environment control. Window bounds, visibility/focus and existing lifecycle events do not prove physical scanout, continuous foreground visibility, or non-overlap. No window is moved or brought to front.

clockDefinitions: Within-process durations subtract monotonic timestamps. Cross-process events use recorded performance.timeOrigin offsets; original clock observations are retained.
RAF timestamp picture gaps preserve the original harness definition and are not physical scanout. postPlaySampleMs is not a complete callback-exit gap.
onGameFrameHookEntryMs measures the JS observation hook after C++ main-loop work. actualRafEntryMs uses the RAF wrapper entry. These different distributions are not additive.
All sample picture gaps over 50 ms by any recorded clock, native callbacks over 50 ms, and all RAF request waits over 250 ms are retained, including startup and stopped-window tails.
limitations: Only P2 uses CPU4 in this local live run. Sampled SDL audio output is retained; browser mute remains on, and this is not acoustic acceptance. First audio-block relative time has no independent performance origin.
900 deterministic input frames and seven confirmed hashes provide limited live correction coverage. This is not the separate depth-8, long-session, results or round-reset gate.
No response-intent probe or RTC packet-level receive/dequeue trace is enabled. Capture-to-display latency and per-packet RTC timing cannot be inferred.
Headed windows and setup/CIM observations change environmental conditions. Visible/focus samples do not prove full-session physical window coverage or scanout.
